%% Calibration deck: enumerate, nested enumerate (numerals 1. to 9.), enumerate in itemize, itemize in enumerate.
\setSlideVersion{1-0-0}
\begin{standardframe}{Numbered lists and nesting}
	\begin{columns}[T,onlytextwidth]
		\begin{column}{0.48\linewidth}
			\begin{enumerate}
				\item First numbered item
				\item Second numbered item
				\begin{enumerate}
					\item One
					\item Two
					\item Three
					\item Four
					\item Five
					\item Six
					\item Seven
					\item Eight
					\item Nine
				\end{enumerate}
				\item Third numbered item
			\end{enumerate}
		\end{column}
		\begin{column}{0.48\linewidth}
			\begin{enumerate}
				\item Numbered, with a bullet list
				\begin{itemize}
					\item A bullet in an enumerate
					\begin{itemize}
						\item And one level deeper
					\end{itemize}
				\end{itemize}
			\end{enumerate}
			\begin{itemize}
				\item A bullet item to compare the text start
				\begin{itemize}
					\item Nested bullet
				\end{itemize}
				\item Another bullet item
				\begin{enumerate}
					\item Numbered in a bullet
					\begin{enumerate}
						\item Third level numbered
					\end{enumerate}
				\end{enumerate}
			\end{itemize}
		\end{column}
	\end{columns}
\end{standardframe}
